A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TCD-DL research. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable and can be matched despite reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original simulation experiments, causal-discovery benchmarks, runtime measurements, and human gene-expression analyses in Section 5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the simulated-network benchmarks, Sachs evaluation, and K562 gene analyses.

M1.justification: The architecture, binary cross-entropy objective, subsampling procedure, and Algorithms 1–2 are unchanged. The Bayesian interpretation and renaming of local inference to subsampled-ensemble inference do not introduce a different procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same random-graph training, E. coli and yeast benchmarks, K562 analyses, small synthetic graphs, and Sachs evaluation. The intervention, mechanism, noise, and fidelity scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Figure 4 and Table 10 retain Random, Correlation, Sortnregress, PMF-GRN, GENIE3, DCD-FG, and AVICI. Table 9 retains PC, GIES, and TCD-DL (direct); no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The sampling budgets, dataset configurations, model settings, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Both versions use the same AUROC, AP, F1 thresholding, and small-graph accuracy protocols.

E4.justification: The causal-distance analysis, training-source ablations, distribution-shift tests, intervention analyses, hyperparameter sweeps, and leukemia case studies are retained. Expanded explanations do not add a new analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report ten random seeds for expression-data sampling and standard deviations in Table 10. No additional uncertainty estimation, significance testing, or calibration analysis is reported.

E6.justification: The matched tables and plotted results retain their values and findings. For example, Table 10 retains TCD-DL AUROCs of 94.6, 81.7, and 71.5 across fidelity levels, and Table 9 retains 76.4% Sachs accuracy. The added explanation of the 30% literature-supported MYC predictions restates existing evidence.

T1.justification: Section 2.2 adds a Bayesian formulation relating graph and ancestor-set posteriors. Section 4.2 explicitly defines ancestor labels for arbitrary subsamples, while Proposition 2 retains its root-inclusion condition. The three propositions and Appendix A proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction now conditions effectiveness on the availability of high-fidelity simulators and removes the specific assertion about prioritizing accessible, cost-effective interventions. The central scalability, accuracy, and generalization claims remain.

C2.justification: The new Bayesian discussion interprets TCD-DL as directly approximating an ancestor-set posterior. Section 5.1 expands the finite-data identifiability discussion and describes estimates as calibrated, without adding calibration evidence. The introduction also makes the simulator-fidelity dependency explicit.

D1.justification: Appendix B.4 now explicitly links full yeast inputs to out-of-memory problems in the stated computing environment. This is a limited resource clarification; architecture, hyperparameters, preprocessing, hardware, training time, and code-access information otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Glass et al. (2013) and Sisson et al. (2018), removes Karlebach and Shamir (2008) and Martin and Sung (2018), and expands positioning relative to amortized Bayesian causal discovery. The GRN discussion moved to Appendix D is retained material.

P1.justification: v3 revises the title and introduction, adds Section 2.2 and a Broader Impact Statement, moves GRN-related work to Appendix D, and clarifies several methodological paragraphs. Terminology and publication headers are updated, while most prose and the overall organization remain intact.

P2.justification: All fifteen figures and ten tables are retained without substantive graphical redesign. Publication headers, caption edits, and text reflow alter placement, including Algorithms 1–2 and Figures 6–7.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves scope and exposition by explicitly stating the high-fidelity simulator dependency and clarifying the existing inference and labeling procedure. Its empirical evidence and proofs are retained. The new description of estimates as calibrated lacks calibration evidence, limiting the benefit of the stronger probabilistic framing.
